stale_telemetry.title: Water heater data is stale
stale_telemetry.description: The iCOMM relay is running, but the tank has not reported for {age} minutes (LAN session: {lan}; relay health: {health}). The water heater shows its last-known values and writes are still accepted and queued. If this persists, check the relay's Pending write and Relay health sensors, or power-cycle the water heater's breaker.
